scientific_role: Development-only falsification of the published content-based selective parent certificate against cheap causal-order baselines; not a new prospective result or an optimized combined predictor.

published_content_contract.candidate_set: fingerprint-valid endpoints in the same physical run at child depth minus one; at least two candidates; recorded parent masked from ranking

order_baselines.max_prior_step: Among the fixed candidate set, retain candidates with lineage.step strictly less than child.step; predict only if exactly one candidate has the maximum retained step; otherwise abstain.
order_baselines.nearest_prior_manifest_row: Among the fixed candidate set, retain candidates whose row occurs strictly before the child in the immutable concatenated blind-manifest order; predict the candidate with the maximum retained row position.
order_baselines.latest_prior_generation_time_secondary: Among the fixed candidate set, retain candidates with a strictly earlier timezone-aware generation_started_at_utc value; predict only if exactly one candidate has the latest retained timestamp; otherwise abstain. This baseline is secondary and cannot rescue either primary baseline.

primary_population.rows: The exact 2691 published content-selected test edges, recomputed from the immutable snapshot and fixed Jaccard-margin threshold.
primary_population.comparison: For each primary order baseline separately, restrict to rows where that baseline predicts; compare content and order correctness on exactly the same rows.

breadth_gates_on_strongest_order_threat.strongest_threat_selection: Among primary baselines that pass hard support, minimize baseline errors on comparable rows; break ties by primary_in_fixed_order.

classification_rule: Integrity failure takes precedence, followed by hard-support failure. Strongest requires every aggregate gate for both primary baselines plus every task/run breadth and anti-dominance gate for the fixed strongest threat. Aggregate-only requires all primary aggregate gates but fails at least one breadth gate. Otherwise the cheap order explanation is not ruled out.
mandatory_outputs: exact reproduction of the published content-selected test population
coverage, correctness, errors and four-cell paired correctness table for each order baseline
content-to-order error ratio and content-only/order-only wins
strongest-threat selection receipt fixed by the protocol
anonymous task/run disagreement breadth and anti-dominance
parent-before-child step and manifest-order integrity counts
secondary generation-time baseline with no rescue authority

claim_boundary.allowed_if_strong: On the disclosed development time split and fixed selected population, identifier-erased content similarity reduces recorded-parent recovery errors relative to both fixed causal-order baselines with the stated aggregate and anonymous task/run breadth; this is a falsification control for the release audit, not a new lineage algorithm.
claim_boundary.allowed_if_below_gate: The published content certificate remains numerically valid, but this falsification does not rule out a cheap causal-order explanation and the content-specific interpretation must be weakened.
